applications.basis: M1 records receipt on 2026-03-01; M2 states on 2026-03-03 that the application will not move forward. The submission record identifies the recorded resume variant as implementation, but the exact artifact was not retained.
M3 says on 2026-03-05 that Example Labs would like to interview for Support Engineer B. No submission record identifies the resume used for B.
M4 records receipt on 2026-03-04 and says the application has not yet been reviewed. No submission record identifies the resume used for C.

M5 says on 2026-03-06 that Demo Remote cannot employ residents of the applicant's state for this role. This is an eligibility restriction, not evidence of a resume weakness, and no submission record identifies the resume used for D.

M6 says on 2026-03-07 that the requisition was cancelled and no one would be hired. A closed requisition is not evidence of a resume weakness, and no submission record identifies the resume used for E.

M7 records a non-progression message on 2026-03-02, but the later correction in M8 on 2026-03-08 says F reopened and requests an interview; the later reply controls the status. No submission record identifies the resume used for F.
